hp_share: a third of the giant's remaining HP (BOSSES.md)
spawn: play Spawn at the spawn offset at the giant's Split burst frame
rejoin: play Rejoin, then fly the shard to the giant over ~0.6 s; the giant's Rejoin forms at frame 30

Climb_Up.note: authored with the pivot fixed; at the last frame move the transform by the end offset and continue with Climb_Loop (pivot on the top surface) or Walk

Climb_Loop.playback: speed / (0.8 x scale) loops per second x 34 frames
Climb_Loop.note: pivot on the top surface; in place; pin the IK_* markers to the climb layer

Climb_Down.note: starts with the pivot on the top surface (Climb_Loop / Climb_Up end pose); at the last frame move the transform by the end offset

round29.foot_markers: none: no IK markers on the shards (baked clips plus a slope tilt, as Unity climbs the bosses)
round29.note: round-28 boss climb conventions: Climb_Up/Climb_Down authored with the pivot fixed, move the transform by end_offset_forward_m / end_offset_up_m on the last frame; Climb_Loop in place on the top surface
